sourceClaims.claim: group and item source sets define three sizes, optional icons and selected/unselected/disabled item paint
group width is composition/content-driven rather than equal distribution
the executable SHLZ model is a native radio group; the library owns visuals and no behavior controller

evidence.source-integrity: pass: primary Segment.svg group/item sets and their absent selected-disabled combination are recorded
evidence.structural-contract: pass: executable roots use fieldset, legend, same-name radios and adjacent visual labels
evidence.runtime-browser: pass: real pointer, Space and Arrow selection use native radio state with counters asserted per path; disabled forced-pointer, focus, Space and programmatic paths emit no events
evidence.accessibility: pass: native radiogroup naming, mutual exclusion, focus order, real Space/Arrow movement and disabled focus exclusion are exercised
evidence.focused-visual: pass: component-local selected, unselected, disabled, focus, three sizes and icon content are captured
evidence.consumer-integration: not-applicable: no application-owned or Data Workspace Segment consumer exists on this baseline
evidence.responsive-content-stress: pass: long labels stay within a component-local narrow fixture without page-level inference

findings.description: The browser fieldset min-content floor allowed a medium Segment to exceed its narrow audited container.

knownLimitations: navigation and command-group semantics are outside Segment
